tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Deepest background. The abyss behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Primary ground plane for all content.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Card and section backgrounds. One step above the ground.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces, hover states, active areas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Warm parchment on dark, deep umber on light. 12:1+ on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions. 4.5:1+ on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, decorative numbers, faint labels. Not for essential content — decorative only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The spotlight. Amber highlight for links, active states, key elements. Use sparingly — tenebrism demands restraint.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent on hover. Slightly brighter in dark, slightly darker in light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint for backgrounds, hover fills, subtle emphasis areas.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills. Dark on amber in dark theme, white on amber in light.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Structural lines, dividers, card borders. Hairline (1px) — structure, not decoration.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error states, destructive actions. 4.5:1+ on surface-100.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger tint for backgrounds and warning areas.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus indicator. 2px solid ring with 2px gap in surface color. 3:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headings. One per page maximum.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy. Set in ink on surface-100 or surface-200.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary body text, descriptions, metadata captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: All-caps tracked labels. Section markers, tags, navigation items, status badges.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Section numbers (01, 02), tech stack labels, metadata, inline code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight internal padding. Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact padding, inline element spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, standard component gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section inner padding, card-to-card gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Component-level spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing within a page region.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Major section breaks.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page-level vertical rhythm between regions.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Sharp corners. Default for most elements — utilitarian.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle softening. Badges, small chips, inline tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large containers, modals, featured sections.
